title: ExamForge question
description: One practice-exam question. Correctness is tracked by option id, never by position, so the frontend is free to shuffle options[] on every render.

id.description: Stable unique id, unique within an exam. Convention: <exam-prefix>-<zero-padded-number>, e.g. gha-001.

exam.description: Which exam this question belongs to. Must match an exam id in data/exams.json.

domain.description: The exam domain this question tests, used for per-domain scoring and weak-domain tracking. Free text so a new exam can bring its own domain taxonomy.

stem.description: The question text shown to the candidate.

options.description: Answer choices. Order here is authoring order only; the frontend shuffles them per render.

id.description: Option id, unique within this question. Correctness is matched on this, not on position.

correctAnswerId.description: The id of the single correct option. Must be one of options[].id.

explanationCorrect.description: Shown when the candidate answers correctly. Standard, confirming explanation.

explanationIncorrect.description: Shown when the candidate answers incorrectly. Deliberately longer and more detailed teaching text.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for future filtering. Not required by the engine.

isSeed.description: True for hand-written seed questions that exist only to prove the engine. Replaced by the full research-backed set later.
